sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (her move loop): a quick, swaggering run, both pistols in her hands, the hair and the sleeves flying, the LEGS CHANGING OVER
sheets.weapons: THE TWO PISTOLS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the FAR pistol in her far hand, the NEAR pistol in her near hand - dark barrels, gold fittings, flared muzzles, her hands round the grips - aimed forward, raised to the sky or hanging as the pale figure holds them; never a third pistol. Only these: no muzzle flash, no bullets, no smoke.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: STRIDE: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) reaching forward (image right), the FAR leg behind pushing off. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) leads, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) - frames 1 and 5 must look different: the other leg in front. Follow the pale figure's LEGS exactly; never the same leg in front in every frame (Talon's first run did that: 「走路没有换腿」).
